children: Following are the results of the Philippine Bureau of the Treasury's (BTr) auction of T-bills on Monday:
BTr awards 42 billion pesos ($669 million), within the programme of 42-60 billion pesos.
BTr awards 20 billion pesos of 91-day T-bills at avg rate of 5.348% versus previous auction avg of 5.214%
BTr awards 15 billion pesos of 182-day T-bills at avg rate of 5.781% versus previous auction avg of 5.622%
BTr awards 7 billion pesos of 364-day T-bills at avg rate of 5.922% versus previous auction avg of 5.807%
Details are on the BTr's website www.treasury.gov.ph
